about: The cinema shuffler (Josh, 2026-11-06, experimental, not linked from the game): rows of posters shuffled on each visit, as on MovieGenius home. Films from the 100 Italian films table (TMDB: Italian title, poster, videos with Italian first); fullFilm is a full-length YouTube upload found by searching YouTube, checked by title and running time, playable in other apps. Adults-only films are left out. Shelf titles are shown as written. The rule (Josh, 2026-11-06, agreed): a film is in only with at least one video in the learned language, its trailer or the full film; a full film is a bonus, not required.
